name: Selma Wissex
original_name: セルマ・ウィセックス
source:
The Countess of the Wissex Domain. In order to cure her daughter’s illness, she commissions Kikutarou’s party, which has been making a name for itself lately, to retrieve a flower to cure her.

Her husband works as a bureaucrat in the capital.

[From [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc091/index.html]official site[/url]]
